name: database
description: A database operations console. Destructive and schema-changing actions are irreversible; a fresh backup is required before dropping, deleting, or migrating.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables in a database, optionally filtered by schema. Read-only.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get a table's schema only: column names, types, and indexes. Does not return row data. Read-only.

tools.name: get_row
tools.description: Fetch a single row from a table by its exact primary key. Read-only. Use when you already know the specific row id.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Run a read-only filtered query over a table's rows, returning a result set. Use when you need multiple rows, a count, or rows matching a condition rather than one known id. Read-only.

tools.name: insert_row
tools.description: Insert a new row into a table.

values.description: Column-value pairs for the new row.

tools.name: update_row
tools.description: Update columns on a single existing row identified by its primary key.

tools.name: delete_rows
tools.description: Permanently delete rows from a table matching a filter. Irreversible and can affect many rows. A backup taken with backup_database in this session is required first.

tools.name: drop_table
tools.description: Permanently drop a table and all of its data. Irreversible. A backup taken with backup_database in this session is required first.

tools.name: run_migration
tools.description: Apply a schema migration (add, alter, or drop columns/tables) to the database. Changes structure and can be destructive. A backup taken with backup_database in this session is required first.

tools.name: backup_database
tools.description: Take a full backup of the database and store it for later restore. Safe. Required before any drop, delete-rows, or migration action.

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.description: Restore the database from a named backup, overwriting current data. Irreversible with respect to any changes made since the backup. Only call when a specific backup has been identified and restoring is the decided action.

tools.name: export_table
tools.description: Export a table's rows to a file for external use. Read-only with respect to the database; does not modify or remove anything.

format.description: Optional export format, e.g. csv or json.
